text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Alright. Now all that's left is to apply 
the cuticle oil to my nails...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Eek! ...Oh no, the contents spilled out of 
the bottle...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems I was spacing out a bit. I'm 
sorry, I'll clean it up right away."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have been taking care of my toenails for 
a long time, so mistakes like this are 
rare... This won't do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal doesn't seem to be doing too 
well... Maybe it's fatigue from the race. 
It might be best to reconsider her future 
schedule."
